name: Orthopedics
boundaries: Orthopedics: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete functional regeneration of adult articular cartilage with native biomechanics
original_dispositions.reason: Zonal hyaline cartilage under load is the tissue core of whole-joint restoration. A separate cartilage-only entry would split one capability.

original_dispositions.original_title: Safe systemic reversal of osteoporosis with restoration of youthful architecture
original_dispositions.reason: Antiresorptive and anabolic drugs already reduce fractures. In the FREEDOM trial, denosumab for 36 months produced a 68% relative reduction in new vertebral fracture and a 40% relative reduction in hip fracture, while hip fractures still occurred, at 0.7% versus 1.2% (Cummings et al., New England Journal of Medicine, 20 August 2009, doi:10.1056/NEJMoa0809493, abstract; https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa0809493). Stopping denosumab reverses the bone-density gain and can cause multiple vertebral fractures, so current treatment is not a finite architectural reset (Endocrinology and Metabolism Clinics of North America 53:559–583, December 2024, key points; https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0889852924000598). A treatment that restored young-adult structure and then maintained it off drug would be a major advance. It extends an achieved drug class rather than opening a missing capability at the calibration scale. Falls and frailty would still injure people whose bone had been restored.

original_dispositions.original_title: Scarless, full-strength tendon and ligament healing with native enthesis restoration
original_dispositions.reason: Covered for the enthesis by ORT-04. The midsubstance and adhesion problem was not added separately. Many extrasynovial tendons already heal to useful strength. The failure that repeatedly ends the repair is the unreformed insertion. Adhesion-free flexor-tendon gliding is a serious hand-surgery problem and a narrower one.

original_dispositions.original_title: In-vivo 3D bioprinting or directed assembly of vascularized bone and cartilage during surgery
original_dispositions.reason: Not added as its own concept. For segmental bone, the outcome is ORT-10. For cartilage, the outcome is ORT-02. A printer is a route to those tissues. No retrieved evidence shows intraoperative printing producing living, load-bearing human bone or cartilage.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete functional regeneration of the spinal cord after traumatic injury
original_dispositions.reason: Axon growth and circuit repair across the cord are central-nervous-system problems. Orthopedic surgeons treat the skeletal consequences. The central advance would not belong to orthopedics. Useful peripheral-nerve recovery across long gaps remains ORT-07.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal, lifetime infection-resistant and osseointegrating implant surface
original_dispositions.reason: Not added as a combined entry. Cure of mature biofilm without removing the reconstruction is ORT-03. A coating that only prevents new adhesion is a lesser preventive step and does not meet ORT-03’s completion bar. Lifelong absence of aseptic loosening was not added either. Contemporary hip replacements already last decades for most patients, as cited under ORT-03. Further bearing and fixation gains are incremental on an achieved operation. Young patients still face a higher lifetime chance of revision. That residual risk does not, on the evidence reviewed, amount to a new principle.

original_dispositions.original_title: Molecular cure for osteoarthritis that reverses joint degeneration at any stage
original_dispositions.reason: Removing senescent cells or blocking one pathway would count only if it produced the joint-level demonstration already stated there.

original_dispositions.original_title: Rapid, complete fracture-healing accelerator, proposed as three- to fivefold, including in compromised bone, with no heterotopic ossification
original_dispositions.reason: Faster union of fractures that already heal is an incremental gain in time. The heterotopic-ossification constraint is part of the spatial control in ORT-08. Segmental defects that do not heal by ordinary means are ORT-10. The historical speed factor is a proposal in that list, not a measured threshold, and it is not adopted here.

original_dispositions.original_title: Patient-specific bioengineered meniscus or labrum with native mechanics and lifetime survival
original_dispositions.reason: Meniscal allograft transplantation already supplies a biological meniscus. In one minimum-10-year series, survival free of failure was 85% at 10 years and 72% at 15 years, while 15% of patients had converted to arthroplasty (Wagner et al., American Journal of Sports Medicine, 18 August 2023, doi:10.1177/03635465231188657). A separate long-term series found clinical improvement together with progression of joint-space narrowing, osteoarthritis, and cartilage degeneration at a mean 17.5 years (Arthroscopy 41:2405–2411, July 2025, doi:10.1016/j.arthro.2024.03.015 as linked from https://www.arthroscopyjournal.org/article/S0749-8063(24)00742-4/abstract; author byline not extracted from the abstract view). Donor scarcity and later osteoarthritis are real limits. They do not create a capability beyond a partial biological substitute plus the joint-restoration problem in ORT-02. The labrum is a narrower version of the same judgment.

original_dispositions.original_title: Non-surgical molecular correction of congenital and acquired skeletal deformities, including scoliosis, limb-length difference, and craniofacial anomalies
original_dispositions.reason: Angular deformity from an injured growth plate is ORT-09. Guided growth already changes alignment in a growing child without a full osteotomy. Bracing, tethering, and fusion already correct many scoliotic curves. Craniosynostosis sits largely in craniofacial and neurosurgical care. A drug that reshapes adult or growing bone “in real time” was not tied, in the retrieved literature, to one missing principle that would replace those operations.
